tracks.title: Turang, Geser Dulu
tracks.mood: riang, menggoda, bergoyang (cheerful, teasing, made for dancing)
tracks.subject: At a Kabanjahe kerja tahun, a Karo boy and his cousin turang, who by custom must open the landek together, plot to swap partners so each can dance with the person he or she actually likes.
